# PMI BA Input-Output Crosswalk

**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Covers every named input and output across all 35 business analysis processes in the PMI Guide to Business Analysis. Also includes the four common inputs that apply to every BA process (PMI BA §1.3.1, lines 2738-2743).

## Legend

| Treatment | Meaning |
|-----------|---------|
| **Catalog  -  ID** | Article is an actionable artifact worthy of prescription. |
| **Alias → ID** | Different PMI name for a concept already in the catalog. |
| **Part of ID** | Content belongs inside the specified catalog artifact. |
| **Context input** | EEF/OPA/expert judgment  -  external factor, not prescribed. |
| **Lifecycle state** | An updated version of another artifact. |
| **Intermediate work product** | Produced within a process, consumed by another, but not a standalone maintained artifact. |
| **Outcome** | Emergent result, not prescribed. |
| **Technique referent** | Referenced as a tool or technique rather than a formal output. |

## Common Inputs (Apply to All BA Processes)

From PMI BA §1.3.1 (lines 2738-2743):

| Term | Treatment | Notes |
|------|-----------|-------|
| Organizational process assets (OPAs) | **Context input** | External to the project. Not an artifact. |
| Enterprise environmental factors (EEFs) | **Context input** | External to the project. Not an artifact. |
| Expert judgment | **Context input** | Skill/technique, not an artifact. |
| Business analysis plan | **Catalog  -  BA-12** | Already in catalog. |
